summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 22 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the __main__ block, added two docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one changelog entry under Unreleased/Added linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (0 deleted lines). Nothing was committed. Tests, black, and mypy were not run because the instructions prohibit running repository code, so the code was verified by reading only. Choices made: text vs. binary is decided on the raw mode string, so 'tr' returns a binary reader; open uses io.open internally to avoid the shadowed builtin; a task may be left orphaned if the handle open fails after the task is added; one mypy suppression on the module-level open return may be unnecessary. Next step: run pytest, black --check, and mypy.
